findings.title: Deployment jobs/worker: 0/2 ready (NoPods)
findings.summary: The deployment wants 2 pod(s) but none exist. Pod creation is being rejected: check the controller's events for quota, admission webhook or pod security errors.
evidence: no pods exist for this workload

steps.description: Read the controller's conditions and events
Pod creation errors land on the ReplicaSet/StatefulSet (quota exceeded, webhook denied, pod security)

findings.title: Deployment web/cart: 1/2 ready (CrashLoopBackOff)
findings.summary: 1 of 2 replicas of deployment cart are ready. Dominant reason: containers crash on start.
evidence: cart-6f7a8b9c0d-bad22 [CrashLoopBackOff, node ip-10-116-165-196]: container cart crash-looping (restarts=12, last exit 1 Error)

steps.description: Read the crash output from the previous container instance
Check exit code, reason and limits

verify: kubectl get pods -n web | grep cart

findings.title: StatefulSet logging/fluentd: chronic OOMKills (915 restarts)
findings.summary: Pods keep restarting (up to 915 times) and restarted again within the last hour. Each OOMKill drops in-flight work (for log shippers: buffered logs). The memory limit is too low for the steady-state load, or there is a leak.
evidence: fluentd-0 [OOMKilled, node ip-10-116-165-196]: container fluentd restarted 2m ago (OOMKilled), restarts=915; Ready again now

steps.description: Read the crash output from the previous container instance
Check exit code, reason and limits

verify: kubectl get pods -n logging | grep fluentd

findings.title: Deployment app-stage/reconciler: 1 evicted/failed pod(s) (emptyDir "reconciler-log" exceeded its 1G limit)
findings.summary: 1 pod(s) were evicted because the workload outgrew its own storage limit (emptyDir "reconciler-log" exceeded its 1G limit). This recurs: the app writes to local disk faster than it is cleaned up. It is scaled to 0 now, so nothing is down, but it will be evicted again when scaled back up.
evidence: reconciler-7d67bf7f59-jqjm7 [Evicted, node ip-10-116-165-196, created 3d ago]: Usage of EmptyDir volume "reconciler-log" exceeds the limit "1G".

steps.description: Find what fills the volume (usually file logging): log to stdout, rotate, or ship logs off the pod
Or raise the emptyDir sizeLimit / ephemeral-storage limit if the usage is legitimate
Clean up the leftover Failed pods (they hold no resources, only clutter)

findings.title: Deployment web/cart: 1 evicted/failed pod(s) (node was low on memory)
findings.summary: 1 pod(s) left in Failed state (node was low on memory). The controller replaced them; these are leftovers.
evidence: cart-6f7a8b9c0d-old33 [Evicted, node ip-10-116-165-196, created 30h ago]: The node was low on resource: memory. Threshold quantity: 100Mi, available: 80Mi.

steps.description: Check the node's pressure findings and which pods consumed the resource
Clean up the leftover Failed pods (they hold no resources, only clutter)
